headline: A 2001 executive order bans bringing rough, uncut diamonds from Sierra Leone into the United States.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Bill Clinton, prohibits importing rough diamonds from Sierra Leone into the United States. Rough diamonds are diamonds that have not yet been cut or polished. No summary was provided, so details such as exceptions, penalties, or how the ban is enforced are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They cannot legally bring rough diamonds from Sierra Leone into the United States.

who_it_affects.group: Diamond sellers and exporters in Sierra Leone
who_it_affects.how: They lose the United States as a legal market for their rough diamonds.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 18, 2001; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
